narr: Thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in extreme southeastern Pennsylvania on the evening of September 10. Rainfall totals were as high as 2 to 3 inches.
ev: Philmont Avenue was closed due to flooding at Tomlinson Road in Lower Moreland Township.
Sections of Kensington Avenue in Philadelphia became impassable due to flooding.
Flooding occurred along Poquessing Creek in Bensalem.
Minor flooding occurred along the Pennypack Creek in Northeast Philadelphia.
Roadway flooding with some roads becoming impassable in the Parkwood and Normandy sections of Northeast Philadelphia.
lsr: Video shared on social media of Kensington Avenue completely flooded. Video indicates sewer system could not handle amount of rainfall seen.
